title: KCP realm_show result (DESIGN.md §10.1, §11.6.1 read family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for realm_show (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). The visible Realm projection (gap notes KG4/KG16).

displayName.description: Display name bounded by the §11.8 cap of 256 Unicode scalar values, length-bounded again at admission.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

home_region.description: Home write-boundary region (§10.1); opaque — no region vocabulary is pinned.

encryption_key_ref.description: Secret-manager reference, never key material (§10.1: endpoint credentials are secret-manager references, not fields in this portable record).

realm.description: Realm projection, field names verbatim from the §10.1 record shape (gap note KG4); status is named with no value space (gap note KG6).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

statusToken.description: Bounded lowercase token for a field DESIGN.md names without pinning a value space; pins the shape without inventing an enum (gap note KG6).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
